obligation: Table32 reference initializer expressions and supported func/extern table nullability on the sole shared VM, preserving captured instance/function identity and initialization order.
representation: WasmTable owns TableType and one WasmReferenceInitializer. Null/Function(index) facts are shared with element items; one frontend decoder, canonical-pool/domain validator and VM evaluation operation own their semantics. Instantiation creates/root environment, initializes tables, applies active elements, then calls start. The existing closure cache owns identity; no new reference encoding or executor. A shared reference_subtype operation checks supported func/extern heap type and nullability in table.copy lowering/runtime and element/table initialization. Function-index segments use the validator authoritative non-null RefType::FUNC; explicit expression segments retain their declared type.
api_change: Runtime-next table lowering accepts WasmTable definitions; TableType.into() supplies the implicit-null initializer. WasmElementValue is replaced by the broader WasmReferenceInitializer shared by table and element facts. All repository callers migrated.
scope: 69 pinned files from the preceding start/element/table ratchet, including table.wast/ref_func.wast and every top-level start file. Shared instantiation callers and non-null table declarations in elem.wast/table.wast are included. No full suite.

checks.node_oracle: jitless Node: initializer values, shared function identities, active-element overwrite, start order, non-null source copy to nullable table, non-null init/grow/fill, per-instance independence

unit_test_policy: Extended serialized_elements_preserve_foreign_capture_ownership_and_reject_unregistered_type_facts with a Function initializer and table/element identity assertion; serialization/GC/cross-instance ownership remain internal checks. No new ordinary suite-duplicating unit tests.
upstream_semantic_source: Pinned wasmparser validator/core.rs: function-index element items have RefType::FUNC, active segment type must subtype the target; table initializer expression checked against declared reference type.
limitations: Imports and imported/global-dependent reference initializers remain unsupported.
Concrete typed/GC heap types, non-null function-boundary signatures, SIMD, table64/shared and remaining memory/proposal forms still incomplete.
